doc:
# Entanglement Wedge — Entanglement Entropy

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “entanglement wedge”).

claims.name: entanglement_wedge_defined_collection_bulk
claims.statement: The entanglement wedge is defined as the collection of bulk subsystems minimizing generalized entropy $A_B(\mathbf{b}) + S(\mathbf{b})$ that are reconstructible from the boundary.

sources.title: Quantum minimal surfaces from quantum error correction

claims.name: entanglement_wedge_defined_domain_dependence
claims.statement: The ENTANGLEMENT WEDGE is defined as the domain of dependence of any spatial bulk region with the extremal surface $\tilde{A}$ as one boundary and a Cauchy surface in $D_A$ as the other boundary; it is larger than the causal wedge and dual to the density matrix $\rho_A$.

claims.name: entanglement_wedge_denoted_mathcal_mathcal
claims.statement: The entanglement wedge, denoted $\mathcal{W}_{\mathcal{E}}[\mathcal{A}]$, is a bulk spacetime region bounded on one side by $D[\mathcal{A}]$ and on the other by $\mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{A}}$.

claims.name: show_bulk_region_reconstructable_given
claims.statement: We show that the bulk region reconstructable from a given boundary subregion—which we term the reconstruction wedge—can be much smaller than the entanglement wedge even when backreaction is small.

sources.title: Large Breakdowns of Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction

claims.name: entanglement_wedge_codimensionzero_bulk_region
claims.statement: The entanglement wedge is a codimension-zero bulk region naturally associated with the given boundary spatial region.

claims.name: entanglement_wedge_proposed_most_natural
claims.statement: The entanglement wedge is proposed to be the most natural bulk region corresponding to the boundary reduced density matrix.

claims.name: wedge_holography_exhibits_phasetransition_behaviors
claims.statement: Wedge holography exhibits phase-transition behaviors of entanglement entropy for disconnected subsystems as expected in holographic CFTs

claims.name: entanglement_wedge_reconstruction_statement_any
claims.statement: Entanglement wedge reconstruction is the statement that any bulk operator $O_a$ acting within $\mathcal{H}_a$ can always be represented in the CFT by an operator $O_A$ that has support only on $\mathcal{H}_A$.

sources.title: Reconstruction of Bulk Operators within the Entanglement Wedge in Gauge-Gravity Duality

claims.name: entanglement_wedge_bulk_region_most
claims.statement: The entanglement wedge is the bulk region most naturally associated with the boundary reduced density matrix $\rho_{\mathcal{A}}$.

claims.name: single_boundary_reconstruction_region_bulk
claims.statement: A single boundary reconstruction in region $A$ of a bulk operator works for every state in a subspace if the bulk operator lies within the entanglement wedge of $A$ for every state in the subspace, including states entangled with a reference system

sources.title: Learning the Alpha-bits of Black Holes

claims.name: ads_cft_correspondence_bulk_operators
claims.statement: In the AdS/CFT correspondence, bulk operators can be reconstructed as CFT operators in a spatial subregion $A$ provided that they lie in the entanglement wedge of $A$, which improves on prior reconstruction methods that succeeded only in the smaller causal wedge.

sources.title: Reconstruction of Bulk Operators within the Entanglement Wedge in Gauge-Gravity Duality

claims.name: holographic_entanglement_purification_rho_ab
claims.statement: Holographic entanglement of purification $E_W(\rho_{AB})$ perfectly matches minimal cross section length calculation

sources.title: Holographic Entanglement of Purification from Conformal Field Theories

claims.name: propose_entanglement_wedge_most_natural
claims.statement: We propose that the entanglement wedge is the most natural bulk region corresponding to the boundary reduced density matrix.

claims.name: process_introduce_codimensionzero_bulk_region
claims.statement: In the process, we introduce a codimension-zero bulk region, named the entanglement wedge, naturally associated with the given boundary spatial region.

claims.name: holographic_entanglement_entropy_wedge_holography
claims.statement: Holographic entanglement entropy in wedge holography computed via double minimization procedure

claims.name: motivated_properties_tensor_networks_conjecture
claims.statement: Motivated by properties of tensor networks, we conjecture that an arbitrary gravitating region <math display="inline"><mi>a</mi></math> can be assigned a generalized entanglement wedge <math display="inline"><mi>E</mi><mo>⊃</mo><mi>a</mi></math>, such that quasilocal operators in <math display="inline"><mi>E</mi></math> have a holographic representation in the full algebra generated by quasilocal operators in <math display="inline"><mi>a</mi></math>.

claims.name: holographic_entanglement_purification_defined_minimal
claims.statement: Holographic entanglement of purification defined as minimal area of entanglement wedge cross section

sources.title: Holographic Entanglement of Purification from Conformal Field Theories

claims.name: entanglement_builds_bridges_macroscopic_entanglement
claims.statement: "Entanglement builds bridges": macroscopic entanglement in holographic theories indicates spatial connectivity in the dual geometry
